answer: The fee is charged through an onyx debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the zenith totals, and the nebula anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 22 units per epoch, sustaining 362 aliases for 29 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 39 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
